targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(value) AS total_kwh FROM readings WHERE topic = 'gridpulse/${site}/grid-01/energy_kwh' AND $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT MAX(value) AS peak_kw FROM readings WHERE topic = 'gridpulse/${site}/grid-01/power_kw' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: The optimiser's target: shave to 90% of the observed peak. If actual load sits at the target, the BESS / load-shift plan is doing its job.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(value) * 0.9 AS peak_target_kw FROM readings WHERE topic = 'gridpulse/${site}/grid-01/power_kw' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Peak target — 90% of peak (kW)

panels.description: Share of readings with quality='good' in the selected period. Below 95%, investigate the gateway before trusting any savings claim from this site.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN quality = 'good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct_good FROM readings WHERE topic LIKE 'gridpulse/${site}/%' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Meter health — % good readings ($site)

panels.description: Grid power (net site load), solar output, and BESS power. BESS is signed: positive = discharging to the site, negative = charging.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value AS "grid" FROM readings WHERE topic = 'gridpulse/${site}/grid-01/power_kw' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS "time", value AS "solar" FROM readings WHERE topic = 'gridpulse/${site}/solar-01/power_kw' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS "time", value AS "bess" FROM readings WHERE topic = 'gridpulse/${site}/bess-01/power_kw' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Load, solar and BESS — $site (kW)

panels.description: Every non-grid asset's power, split by asset name. Use this to find which asset caused a peak, not just when the peak happened.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", split_part(topic, '/', 3) AS "asset", value FROM readings WHERE topic LIKE 'gridpulse/${site}/%/power_kw' AND topic NOT LIKE 'gridpulse/${site}/grid-01/%' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Asset load — $site (kW)

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', ts) AS "time", SUM(value) AS "kwh" FROM readings WHERE topic = 'gridpulse/${site}/grid-01/energy_kwh' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Commands table: requested vs allowed kW and the BMS reason. A rejected or clamped row is the safety plane working, not a failure. Populated only when commands are written to the commands table (full-stack path).

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", topic, requested_kw, allowed_kw, reason FROM commands WHERE topic LIKE 'gridpulse/${site}/%' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Gated BESS commands — $site

list.label: Site
list.name: site
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT split_part(topic, '/', 2) AS __value FROM readings WHERE topic LIKE 'gridpulse/%' ORDER BY 1
